shared_elements: figural imagery on a flat stone surface
multiple figures arranged in a sequence/register
justification: A shows a carefully modelled low relief of standing, bearded human figures in profile with elaborate garments, hair and weapons, facing and gesturing toward one another; B shows painted schematic outline motifs (apparently boat-like curved lines with hooked ends and small stroke-rows, plus indistinct shapes) laid out in loose horizontal bands. The only correspondence is the generic one of figural motifs arranged in rows on a stone surface, while the specific subjects, proportions, and the naturalistic-relief versus flat-outline conventions differ completely.
